errors.text: The hypothesis assigns the critical ordering primarily to B2, whereas the target mechanism centers on enhanced L12 ordering toward Ni3Al stoichiometry within FCC domains.
It replaces the key jagged FCC/B2 phase-boundary morphology and stress concentration at jagged tips with a largely unsupported coherent-to-incoherent boundary transition.
It does not specify the experimentally relevant embrittlement window of approximately 550–750 °C, the ductility minimum near 600 °C, or recovery near 750 °C.
The cited evidence does not establish that elevated antiphase-boundary energy in the relevant ordered domains suppresses cross-slip and promotes planar slip.
